summary: Iteration 14 follow-up testing. BACKEND: /app/backend/tests/test_serve_placement.py re-run → 7/7 PASS (serve placement zone for deuce+ad court, receiving tip, 422 validation, /api/health advisor_ready, highlight-reel stream, nutrition stream). FRONTEND (preview URL, player@matchtracker.app): (1) WAKE LOCK HOIST — VERIFIED FIXED: spied navigator.wakeLock.request via add_init_script; a full Quick-mode match (Rohan 4-0 4-0 Aditya, 32 points, 8 game transitions + 1 set transition) produced exactly 1 request (was 16 in iteration 13), 0 releases mid-match, 0 console errors. Reproduced twice, 1 request both times. (2) STORY PNG DESIGN — VERIFIED FIXED: exported story-Rohan-vs-Aditya.png 1080x1920, 221,556 bytes with a completed 234-char AI recap and 2 real advisor tips. The vertical court centre line is GONE (only the faint outer court rect remains, no line through the score row/recap). COACH WHISPERED section now renders below the recap in the lower half and fills the previously-empty ~300px band with the 2 coach tips. A second export taken while the recap was still streaming (122KB) also rendered correctly (empty recap area, no crash). (3) TIMEZONE — no regression: browser TZ offset is 0 (UTC) as expected, todayLocalIso() == UTC date here so the fix is neutral; dates.js logic reviewed and correct. (4) TodaysMatchHero — STILL NOT RENDERING (iteration 13 blocker NOT fixed). (5) Tournaments historical filter — STILL NOT MOUNTING. Root cause found and proven (see rca_of_the_issue): tournamentsMock seeds event category='BS'/ageGroup='U-18', but normalizeEventSegment() requires category='Boys Singles' and ageGroup='U18' (regex /^U(\d+)$/) and returns {category:'Boys', subcategory:'U-18'} — which can never equal the dashboard circuit {category:'U18', subcategory:'Singles'} built from mockRankingHistory. All 3 segments still show '0 <segment> entries' and 'No upcoming ... matches found in your entered draws'. Consequently the launch-tracker prefill flow (opponent/tournament/round/date into the tracker header) could NOT be tested at all.

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL (iteration-13 blocker NOT fixed): the new seed never matches any dashboard segment, so data-testid='todays-match-hero' and data-testid='tournaments-history-filter' still never render. Two independent defects: (a) seed uses category:'BS' and ageGroup:'U-18' while normalizeEventSegment() needs 'Boys Singles' + 'U18' (verified in node: normalizeEventSegment('BS','U-18')=null, ('Boys Singles','U-18')=null, ('Boys Singles','U18')={category:'Boys',subcategory:'U-16/18'}); (b) even with correct event strings the returned segment {category:'Boys', subcategory:'U-18'} is a DIFFERENT taxonomy from the dashboard circuit {category:'U18', subcategory:'Singles'} produced by buildCircuits() over mockRankingHistory, so the equality check in useSegmentMatchSchedule.js:54 and TournamentsTab.jsx:142 can never be true. Both mock sources must use one taxonomy.

HIGH (will bite immediately after the segment fix): the seed uses draw-size semantics (round: 32 / 16 / 8) but roundToken(matchRound, drawSize, won) expects a 1-based round INDEX. Verified in node: roundToken(32,32)=null, roundToken(16,32)=null, roundToken(8,32)=null; the correct values are 1→R32, 2→R16, 3→QF, 4→SF, 5→F. So the hero header would show no 'QF' token and the tracker prefill round would be '' — exactly the assertion in the test request.

MEDIUM: Round is a <select> whose options are 'Round of 32'|'Quarterfinal'|... but the prefill from TodaysMatchHero passes roundToken output ('QF'/'R16'/'SF'). A prefilled 'QF' matches no <option>, so the select will silently show blank and the round is lost when the match is saved. Needs a token→label map (or add token options).

ui_bugs.component: tournamentsMock seed coverage vs test expectation
ui_bugs.issue: LOW/INFO: the request states '5 seeded entries in the segment', but only 3 of the 5 seeded events are U-18 (e-last-year-u18s is ageGroup 'U-16' and e-two-yr-u16s is U-16). Once the taxonomy is fixed the U18 segment will have 3 entries all dated inside the current calendar year (today, -30d, -120d) — so no 'last year' filter-year chip will exist in that segment. Move the last-year/two-year events into the same age group (or add year-spanning U-18 events) if the year-chip scenario should be demoable.

integration_issues.issue: UNTESTABLE — hero never renders (see CRITICAL above), so navigate('/track', {state:{trackerPrefill}}) and the header prefill (opponent 'Iyer, Neel', tournament 'Deccan Open Under-18', round QF, date today) could not be exercised end-to-end. Must be retested after the segment/taxonomy fix.

UNTESTABLE — tournaments-history-filter is gated behind segmentEntries.length > 0 which is still 0. filter-this-year / filter-year-YYYY / filter-last-12m / filter-range / filter-range-inputs / tournaments-empty-filtered were all unreachable. Filter logic was code-reviewed instead and looks correct (local-date helpers used, inclusive range, empty-filtered state present).

issues: FIXED: centre line removed; FIXED: COACH WHISPERED block now fills the lower half for short recaps.

Remaining nit: recap + tips text is drawn at x=80 with maxWidth W-160, i.e. exactly on the decorative court rect drawn at strokeRect(80,480,W-160,...). Long tip lines touch/appear to overflow the border — give the text ~30px inner padding (x=110, maxWidth W-220).

Remaining nit: each tip is hard-capped at 2 lines, so the 2nd tip renders as 'open forehand side.…' (ellipsis directly after a full stop) even though ~40px of vertical space was still free below. Consider allowing 3 lines when space permits, or dropping the ellipsis when the text already ends in punctuation.

action_items: CRITICAL: unify the mock segment taxonomy. Either (a) change mockRankingHistory CIRCUITS to {category:'Boys', subcategory:'U-18'|'U-16'} and tournamentsMock EVENTS to category:'Boys Singles', ageGroup:'U18'/'U16', or (b) make normalizeEventSegment output the U18|Singles shape. Today normalizeEventSegment() returns null for every seeded event AND its output shape can never equal the dashboard circuit shape — so TodaysMatchHero and tournaments-history-filter remain dead code.
HIGH: fix EVENT_MATCHES.round in tournamentsMock to 1-based round indices (1=R32, 2=R16, 3=QF) so roundToken() resolves; currently every round token is null.
MEDIUM: map the prefilled round token ('QF') to a valid Round <select> option ('Quarterfinal') in TrackerPage, else the prefill silently drops the round.
LOW: add year-spanning U-18 events to the seed if the filter-year-<lastyear> chip should be demoable in the default segment.
LOW: Story PNG — add inner horizontal padding for recap/tips so text does not sit on the court border; relax the 2-line tip cap when space remains.
critical_code_review_comments: Two competing segment taxonomies exist in the codebase: buildCircuits/circuitKey over ranking rows ('U18'|'Singles') vs normalizeEventSegment over events ('Boys'|'U-18'). Any comparison across them (useSegmentMatchSchedule.js:54, TournamentsTab.jsx:142) is dead logic. Add a single canonical segment type + converters and unit-test them — this is the second iteration lost to the same class of bug.

tournamentsMock.js still builds its rolling anchor dates with new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10) (UTC) while the consumers now use todayLocalIso() (local). For a UTC+ user after 00:00 the seed's TODAY is one day behind the consumer's today, re-breaking the 'match today' hero. Use toLocalIso() in the mock too.
highlightReelStory.drawWrap returning the y cursor and the tips-space guard (cursor + 100 < tipsBottomLimit) are correct and defensive — good.
useWakeLock hoisted to TrackerPage with a boolean dep is correct: exactly 1 request per match, released on unmount/match end.

rca_of_the_issue: TodaysMatchHero + tournaments-history-filter: proven with a node harness against the real modules. normalizeEventSegment(rawCategory, rawAgeGroup) requires rawCategory to start with Boys|Girls|Men|Women and rawAgeGroup to match /^U(\d+)$/. tournamentsMock seeds category:'BS' and ageGroup:'U-18' → both regexes fail → returns null for all 5 entries → segmentEntries=[] in TournamentsTab (filter block gated on length>0) and upcoming=[] in useSegmentMatchSchedule (hero returns null). Even after fixing the strings, the function returns {category:'Boys', subcategory:'U-18'} whereas the selected circuit from buildCircuits(mockRankingHistory) is {category:'U18', subcategory:'Singles'} — the strict equality on category+subcategory can never pass. Reproduced in the UI across all three segments ('0 U18 Singles entries', '0 U16 Doubles entries', '0 U16 Singles entries'), zero console errors. Secondary: roundToken(m.round=8, drawSize=32) returns null because it expects a 1-based round index, so round tokens/prefill would still be empty after the taxonomy fix.
